verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical 320x50 banners, and both are broken in the same ways. The legal fine print gets the prime left slot at almost body-copy size, where the product thumbnail is cramped. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon has shrunk to an unreadable sliver under the headline. A's logo is just a tiny sun icon with no readable wordmark. B at least shows the SOLSTICE wordmark in the left cluster, so the brand survives slightly better, but the hierarchy and the fine-print problems are the same.
